title: UI风格#116 - MoroccanTiles (摩洛哥瓷砖)
description: 创建第116种UI风格：摩洛哥瓷砖风格 - 几何马赛克、伊斯兰图案、浓郁色彩。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDL.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Moroccan Tiles style When color palette Then features terracotta, turquoise, saffron yellow, rose pink, deep blue
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#E07B39 (赤陶), #40E0D0 (绿松石), #F4D03F (藏红), #FFFAF0 (玫瑰粉), #1E3A5F (深蓝)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Moroccan Tiles style When typography Then uses arabic-influenced: Playfair Display, Cinzel, or Pinyon Script
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Playfair Display (标题), Cinzel (正文), Pinyon Script (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Moroccan Tiles style When layout Then zellige patterns, arch doorways, lantern shadows, geometric grids
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：马赛克图案、拱形门廊、灯笼阴影、几何网格

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Moroccan Tiles style When UI elements Then mosaic animation, lantern glow, geometric tessellation
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：马赛克动画、灯笼发光、几何密铺、伊斯兰图案

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Moroccan Tiles UI When functional Then includes souk chat, merchant agents, bazaar stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：集市聊天、商人代理、市场统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Moroccan Tiles UI When copy Then uses moroccan: 'Souk', 'Zellige', 'Lantern', 'Bazaar'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'SOUK. ZELLIGE. LANTERN.'、按钮'SEND'→'EXPLORE'、'SUBMIT'→'BARGAIN'
